title: Zephyr: message queue IPC
notes:
Already implemented in app_interface subsys
Implemented static bounded bidirectional same-device IPC queues in app_interface: copy ownership, FIFO isolation, queue-full/empty finite waits, K_FOREVER sentinel, mutex/semaphore thread safety, undersized-buffer retry without dequeue, and shutdown/discard/wakeup behavior; added Kconfig bounds and focused ztests. Modified/new files: app_interface/CMakeLists.txt, Kconfig, include/lichen/app_interface/ipc.h, ipc.c, tests/app_interface/prj.conf, tests/app_interface/src/main.c. Validation: git diff --check passed. Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 cross-build linked successfully after working around pre-existing repository/toolchain flag incompatibilities (-std=c23 unsupported by SDK GCC 12 and upstream/header warnings promoted by global -Werror); ipc.c produced no project-code diagnostics. Executable tests remain unrun: native_sim configuration on this Mac fails with Zephyr's explicit 'POSIX architecture only works on Linux' error. Pinned Zephyr v3.7 Linux native_sim validation is still required before close.
